title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: demurrage rate class of a reefer-class container
content:
## Scope

For the final demurrage line of a per-container record under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule decides the rate class at which the demurrage days are billed. It depends on the cargo type of the container's booking.

## Rule

The rate class is taken from the product's equipment class map, except that a reefer-class container is billed at reefer-class rates only when its booking has the cargo type reefer, and a reefer unit moving under a booking of any other cargo type is billed at dry-class rates.

## Condition table

| Mapped rate class | Booking cargo type | Demurrage rates billed |
|---|---|---|
| reefer | reefer | reefer class |
| reefer | not reefer | dry class |
| special | any | special class |
| dry | any | dry class |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A 20-foot reefer unit carries dangerous-goods cargo that is not reefer cargo. Which demurrage class applies?**
A: The dry class, because its booking's cargo type is not reefer.

**Q: A reefer unit moves on a reefer booking. Does the exception apply?**
A: No. It keeps the reefer class the map gives it.
